text: Small leak noticed near the pressure relief valve on Line 4. Cleaned up the area but the primary source was not fully secured.
Operator reported a hissing sound coming from the same pressure relief valve. A low-priority work order was submitted for routine maintenance.
Minor pressure drop recorded on the central control panel. The valve appears to be stuck partially open despite manual override attempts.
Valve handle vibrating excessively during the morning pump start-up sequence. The immediate area was cordoned off as a precaution.
The pressure relief valve completely blew out, causing a massive release of high-pressure fluid. A nearby worker narrowly avoided being struck by flying metal shrapnel. Emergency shutdown initiated.
